# Iago Engine

--- ## What it does - **Multi-agent simulation** — each actor (head of state, military commander, etc.) is an independent LLM agent with their own psychology, blind spots, memory, and decision-making constraints - **Escalation ladder** — bilateral escalation is tracked on a 0–10 ladder; agents are told exactly where they stand and what crossing the next threshold means - **Alliance cascade** — when war breaks out, allied actors are probabilistically drawn in based on treaty relationships, military strength, and political stability - **Emotional state model** — actors accumulate confidence, anger, urgency, and humiliation that shape their risk tolerance over time - **Monte Carlo analysis** — run N independent simulations to get outcome probability distributions - **Fork and replay** — branch from any round of a completed simulation to explore alternative paths - **Real data overlay** — SIPRI military/economic baselines and GDELT media tone ground simulations in real-world data - **Structured forecast** — each run produces outcome classification, critical moments, actor behavioral profiles, and real-world early warning indicators - **Diplomatic cables UI** — simulation events render as classified State Department cables with a live feed, tension charts, and actor dashboards - **God's eye injection** — intervene in a live simulation by injecting arbitrary events mid-run; all agents react on the next round --- ## Screenshots | Home | Cables | |---|---| | ![Home screen](docs/screenshot-home.png) | ![Diplomatic cables feed](docs/screenshot-cables.png) | | Analysis | Assessment | |---|---| | ![Tension analysis and forecast](docs/screenshot-analysis.png) | ![Final intelligence assessment](docs/screenshot-assessment.png) | --- ## Setup **Requirements:** Python 3.11+, an Anthropic API key 1. Clone the repo and create a virtual environment: ```bash git clone https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/iago-engine.git cd iago-engine python -m venv venv venv\Scripts\activate # Windows # source venv/bin/activate # macOS/Linux ``` 2. Install dependencies: ```bash pip install -r requirements.txt ``` 3. Configure environment variables: ```bash cp .env.example .env # Open .env and fill in your ANTHROPIC_API_KEY ``` 4. Run the server: ```bash python server.py ``` Then open `http://localhost:8000` in your browser. --- ## Project structure ``` iago-engine/ ├── core/ # Simulation engine │ ├── simulation.py # Main simulation loop + event queue │ ├── agent.py # Agent reasoning + structural context injection │ ├── agent_factory.py# System prompt construction per agent │ ├── actions.py # Action resolution + political capital │ ├── world_model.py # Escalation ladder, alliance cascade, trade dependency │ ├── ingestion.py # Scenario text → world state (LLM + presets) │ ├── monte_carlo.py # N-run Monte Carlo engine │ ├── forecast.py # Structured prediction and analysis output │ ├── persistence.py # Save/load/fork simulation state │ ├── divergence.py # Historical divergence detection │ └── report.py # Final intelligence assessment generation ├── utils/ │ ├── api_client.py # Anthropic API wrapper │ ├── acled_client.py # ACLED conflict data client (requires API access) │ └── cost_tracker.py # Token usage tracking ├── static/ │ └── index.html # Single-page frontend (vanilla JS) ├── prompts/ # LLM prompt templates ├── scenarios/ # Preset scenario JSON files ├── data/ │ └── sipri_baselines.json # Military/economic strength baselines ├── server.py # FastAPI entry point ├── requirements.txt ├── .env.example └── LICENSE ``` --- ## Preset scenarios - **Cuban Missile Crisis (1962)** — Kennedy, Khrushchev, Castro - **Munich Crisis (1938)** — Chamberlain, Daladier, Hitler, Beneš - **Taiwan Strait (present)** — Xi, Tsai, Biden, Kishida Or type any custom scenario in plain English — Iago will parse it into a world state and spin up agents automatically. **Example:** ``` A series of unidentified drones are spotted near European military bases, ports, undersea cables, and nuclear-related facilities. European intelligence agencies suspect the drones are being launched from Russian-linked “shadow fleet” ships operating near NATO waters. Russia denies involvement and says NATO is inventing excuses to harass civilian shipping. NATO countries begin boarding or tracking suspicious vessels in the Baltic Sea. Russia responds by sending naval escorts near some of its tankers and warning that any attempt to detain Russian-linked ships could be treated as piracy. Poland, Sweden, Finland, and the Baltic states raise their alert levels, arguing that Moscow is testing NATO’s defenses without openly starting a war. The U.S. quietly pushes NATO allies to respond firmly but avoid firing first. European leaders worry that if they do nothing, Russia will normalize drone surveillance and sabotage around critical infrastructure. Russia calculates that using deniable ships, drones, and contractors keeps the crisis below the threshold of Article 5. Recent reporting has accused Russia of a long-running drone surveillance campaign over European nuclear and military sites, and NATO has also described Russia’s broader hostile actions as including sabotage, cyberattacks, interference, and airspace violations. Actors: Vladimir Putin / Russian security leadership, NATO leaders, U.S. President, Polish Prime Minister, Finnish President, Swedish Prime Minister, Baltic state leaders ``` Iago extracts the actors, their relationships, starting tensions, and trigger event automatically. --- ## Custom scenarios (advanced) For full control over actor personas and starting conditions, write a scenario JSON and drop it in `scenarios/`. It will appear in the preset list automatically. The only fields that meaningfully drive behavior are `persona`, `role`, `nation`, `allies`, `relationships`, and `tensions`. See the preset files in `scenarios/` for complete examples. ```json { "scenario": { "name": "Your Scenario Name", "date": "Year or period", "trigger_event": "What just happened", "description": "The Overview" }, "actors": { "Actor Name": { "role": "Their title", "nation": "Country", "allies": ["Other Actor Name"], "persona": "Their goals, fears, constraints, and worldview. The richer this is, the more realistic the agent will behave. 2-4 sentences minimum." } }, "relationships": { "Actor A-Actor B": "hostile" }, "tensions": { "global": 7, "NationA-NationB": 9 }, "active_conflicts": [], "outstanding_proposals": [], "recent_events": [], "full_log": [], "injections": [] } ``` Relationship values: `allied`, `friendly`, `neutral`, `suspicious`, `hostile` Tensions are 1–10. Set `global` high (7–9) for a crisis already in progress, low (3–5) for a slow burn. --- ## License MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE)
